lines.zh: 我四蹄踩在菌丝上，很轻。
lines.en: My four hooves fall lightly on the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我走起来有黏土的闷响。
lines.en: I walk with the dull sound of clay.
I walk the rim of the mycelium.
My mane is modelled from clay too.

lines.zh: 我走过的菌丝被踩低了。
lines.en: The mycelium lies lower where I've passed.
I walk around that big mushroom.

lines.zh: 泥土的脚，走一步陷一步。
lines.en: Clay feet, one step and I sink.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子印留在软土上。
lines.en: My hoofprints stay in the soft soil.
A patch of mycelium grows where I step.
The mycelium sinks under my hooves.
I step over a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴晃得不太自然。
lines.en: My tail swings a little stiffly.

lines.zh: 我走到菌丝地中间站住。
lines.en: I walk to the middle of the mycelium and stop.
I go around a small puddle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往林子那边走。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the woods.
I stand braced on four legs.

lines.zh: 我的颜色是土和菌丝混的。
lines.en: My colour is soil mixed with mycelium.
I don't need to graze.

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛吹起来一点。
lines.en: The wind lifts my mane a little.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有别的蹄声。
lines.en: I hear other hooves far off.
I lower my head and touch the ground.
The clay on me is drying.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，甩了甩头。
lines.en: I snort and toss my head.
My ears stay pricked.
I'm waiting for someone to lead me.
This mycelium is very quiet.
I lean my weight onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 露水在我背上凝成一层。
lines.en: Dew has beaded on my back.
I could sleep standing up.

lines.zh: 我又眨了眨眼，慢慢转开。
lines.en: I blink again and turn away slowly.
You reach out and I don't shy away.
I lower my head and sniff your hand.
A mycelium horse with no recipe.
You touch my neck and I stay still.
My mane is a little stiff.
Are you getting on?
I stand firm on all four hooves.
Let go and I'll walk off.
No one has led me yet.
I tip my head to one side.
A piece of clay falls off me.
I stand at a slant and hold.
Soil crumbles off my body.
A crack opens on my neck.

lines.zh: 我脚底是菌丝，走起来软。
lines.en: Mycelium underfoot makes me soft-stepped.
I slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 土从我的伤口里漏出来。
lines.en: Soil leaks from the break.
Slow, but I can still walk.
Is this clump of mycelium edible?
I lower my head and touch it.
I only know the smell of mycelium.
I move my nose away.
What else have you got?

lines.zh: 我今天一点胃口都没有。
lines.en: I've no appetite at all today.
I move a few paces off.
I look at you, then at the ground.
I flick my tail and walk off.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我咬一口。
lines.en: Not enough for one bite.

lines.zh: 我不像别的马那样贪吃。
lines.en: I'm not greedy like other horses.
It's on the ground; I don't move.
I'll wait for you to put it away.

lines.zh: 这东西会弄脏我的蹄子。
lines.en: That would dirty my hooves.
My clay body sways once.

lines.zh: 这一下在我腿上留了印。
lines.en: That leaves a mark on my leg.
Soil flies up from under our feet.
I plant myself steady.
I walk back to where I was.
That wasn't really a heavy knock.
I look down at my leg.
I'm not angry at all.
She's a clay horse as well.
Her colour is darker than mine.
Our mycelium threads tangle together.

lines.zh: 她的头靠在我的鬃毛上。
lines.en: She rests her head against my mane.
We only touch noses.
We walk a short stretch together.
Her prints lie beside mine.
We stop at the edge of the mycelium.
She heads toward the woods.
I just stay where I am.
I lower my head to take it.
My mouth is too stiff to hold it.
It falls by my hoof.
I push it away with my nose.

lines.zh: 菌丝做的马，配方里都没我。
lines.en: A mycelium horse that no recipe lists.
I kick it into the grass.
I stand on it.
I push it back toward you.
It rolls onto the mycelium.
I don't give it a second look.
Something is moving on the mycelium.
I turn my neck that way.
Both my ears come forward.
I've never seen this before.
I edge over an inch at a time.
My hooves have gone quiet.
Mycelium has grown between my hooves.
I stretch my head out to touch it.
I follow it a while.
It turned into the mycelium.
My hoofbeats are soft.
It stops to listen.
I stop as well.
It starts moving again.
I lower my head.
It's three paces from me.
I speed up just a little.
I come down and the soil splashes.
I rear and lash out with my forelegs.
It lands on its shoulder.
It backs off two paces.
I rear once more.
It hides behind a tree.
I go around the far side of the tree.
My hoof misses its mark.
I don't chase any further.
A clay horse stands on the mycelium.
No one has claimed me yet.
My four legs have just set.

lines.zh: 我身上摸起来还是凉的。
lines.en: I'm still cool to the touch.

lines.zh: 菌丝就在我的蹄子下面。
lines.en: The mycelium lies under my hooves.
I raise my head and look far off.
I lift one leg to test it.
The hoof sinks deep.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己是从哪来的。
lines.en: I don't know where I came from.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都不知道。
lines.en: I don't even know my own name.

lines.zh: 火烤得我发硬，边缘卷了。
lines.en: Fire hardens me and my edges curl.

lines.zh: 落地的时候我断了一条腿。
lines.en: A leg snaps off when I land.
Water soaks me until I sag.
The blast tears a shoulder off.

lines.zh: 那道光把泥从我身上松开。
lines.en: The light loosens the clay on me.
I don't eat grass, and I can still dry out.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我裂开了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I split.
The ground is gone and I keep falling.
